variants.title: Prism on the spectrometer: refractive index of crown glass (N-BK7)
variants.sample: Equilateral prism of borosilicate crown glass, SCHOTT N-BK7
variants.unknown: the refractive index n of the glass at the sodium D line

source.title: SCHOTT N-BK7 data sheet: nF = 1.52238 (486.13 nm), nC = 1.51432 (656.27 nm); the two-term Cauchy constants are fitted to those two lines

variants.title: Prism on the spectrometer: refractive index of barium crown glass (N-BAK4)
variants.sample: Equilateral prism of barium crown glass, SCHOTT N-BAK4, the glass of binocular prisms
variants.unknown: the refractive index n of the glass at the sodium D line

source.title: SCHOTT N-BAK4 data sheet: nF = 1.57591, nC = 1.56575; Cauchy constants fitted to those two lines

variants.title: Prism on the spectrometer: refractive index of flint glass (F2)
variants.sample: Equilateral prism of flint glass, SCHOTT F2
variants.note: Flint glass carries lead oxide: it bends light more, and spreads the colours more, than crown glass.
variants.unknown: the refractive index n of the glass at the sodium D line

source.title: SCHOTT F2 data sheet: nF = 1.63208, nC = 1.61503; Cauchy constants fitted to those two lines

variants.title: Prism on the spectrometer: refractive index of dense flint glass (N-SF10)
variants.sample: Equilateral prism of dense flint glass, SCHOTT N-SF10
variants.note: A very dense glass. Below about 42 degrees of incidence the light cannot leave the second face at all and the image disappears.
variants.unknown: the refractive index n of the glass at the sodium D line

source.title: SCHOTT N-SF10 data sheet: nF = 1.74797, nC = 1.72085; Cauchy constants fitted to those two lines

variants.title: Prism on the spectrometer: refractive index of fused quartz
variants.sample: Equilateral prism of fused quartz (fused silica)
variants.unknown: the refractive index n of fused quartz at the sodium D line

source.title: I. H. Malitson, J. Opt. Soc. Am. 55, 1205 (1965): fused silica n = 1.46313 at 486.13 nm and 1.45637 at 656.27 nm; Cauchy constants fitted to those two lines

variants.title: Hollow prism on the spectrometer: refractive index of water
variants.sample: Hollow glass prism filled with distilled water at 20 C
variants.method: Thin parallel glass walls do not change the deviation: the liquid alone bends the light.
variants.unknown: the refractive index n of water at the sodium D line

source.title: CRC Handbook of Chemistry and Physics: water at 20 C, n = 1.33718 (486.1 nm), 1.33300 (589.3 nm), 1.33141 (656.3 nm); Cauchy constants fitted to the F and C lines
